title: AssertSameAs
description: Emitted by the consolidator after a confident match between two entities. Virtuoso sink writes <a> owl:sameAs <b> in the graph corresponding to the entity type and lets the OWL2-RL reasoner close the equivalence class. Neo4j sink writes a SAME_AS edge between the matched nodes (reviewed=false, confidence + tier carried forward) and lets the existing review-queue tooling pick it up.

rule.description: Consolidator rule that produced this match.
